column1: # Batman: Arkham Knight (Batman: Arkham Trilogy): Rocksteady's Unreal Engine 3 (loose cooked packages, Oodle-compressed), SDK 14.3.0, NVN, Wwise sound, CRI Sofdec
# movies (USM) and Scaleform GFx menus; update 1.0.5 (v327680), which holds the whole game (the base NSP is 7 MB).
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and brought up on the Mac (docs/agents) to the title screen; see README.md for what is open
# Unreal Engine 3 fills its textures in memory pools with the CPU and flushes most of them never: without both keys they stayed empty on the host
# (the colour-grading LUT read back as zeros, so the tone-mapped scene was black, and Scaleform's bitmaps were missing). tex_dirty_upload is the one that matters:
# with tex_flush_upload alone the LUT stays empty
# Presentation and pipelines as Breath of the Wild ships them (dm/games/README.md): present snapshots (a ring of 2 host textures) and render pipelines through MTL4Compiler on iOS with
# the pipeline archive and the prepare step
# a 3D game: D-pad, right stick (camera) and L3 / R3 on the iPhone's virtual gamepad
# The NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: Engage's 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region, where the game maps its memory itself.
# Its FMallocBinned3 (1 GB + 37 GB of address regions) is replaced by the host allocator (patches.py, dm/host/hle_uemalloc.c), so the alias region holds only the SDK's and the engine's own maps
# the NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource
# Unreal Engine 3's global shader cache (GlobalShaderCache-Switch.bin) and the material shader cache package (CombinedShaderCache-Switch.xxx; shader_split.py ue3_package / ue3_records)
# The game keeps one control section for shaders whose control sections differ only from +0x770 on (GLSLC's compile information: the hash at +0x7d0, register counts at +0x790 and a
# word at +0x778), the first one loaded, so a program's control section is often another shader's (31 of 80 shaders the opening used, more in game); keys leave +0x770..+0x7e8 out
# (hle_nvn.c keys_hash, shader_split.py key_ctl). Nothing the translation reads lies there (the code size at +0x704, the compute group at +0x748)
